It amends the list adopted in July 2024 after a consultation that closed on 25 March 2025. I could not locate or fetch the updated PDF within the budget.

issues.detail: Grokbot dates its document 2025-02 from PDF metadata. The council adopted an updated Local Validation Checklist on 3 July 2025, after a consultation that closed on 25 March 2025. A February 2025 file is probably the pre-update or consultation version, not the current list. The update adds minimum thresholds for technical reports on major applications, clarifies when design codes and masterplans are needed, and covers Design Review stages and how self-build status is secured for BNG. Check this by hand, because the PDF could not be fetched.
issues.evidence: Decision 'Update to the adopted Local Validation Checklist for Planning Applications', decision date 03/07/2025

issues.detail: The list date comes from PDF CreationDate metadata, not from text in the document. The known official dates are adoption in July 2024 (consultation 13 June to 11 July 2024) and an update on 3 July 2025.
issues.grok_comment: The basis is PDF metadata, but the document text does carry a date: it is headed "Local Validation Checklist March 2025" (the consultation version, consultation 25 Feb to 25 Mar 2025), so the claim that the text has no date is wrong.
issues.claude_response: Kept, with a correction. The text says March 2025, but that is the consultation version; the adopted update is July 2025. The recorded date still needs fixing.

issues.detail: These tab_items are not requirements: 'Email address (which will be redacted ...) 3.', 'Phone number (which will be redacted ...) 4.', the Planning Portal hard-copy forms text, and strings of link and file names ('BFL-2020-Brochure.pdf Local Plan Policy SDC12 ...', 'Appendix 2 - Proposed Planning Streets and Places September 2024.pdf ...').

Most requirements are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Some placements are wrong on their face: Land Contamination and LVIA are under 'Minerals & waste (county)', a type North East Derbyshire as a district does not determine; Flood Risk Assessment / Drainage Strategy appears only under 'Change of use - prior approval'; Arboricultural report appears only under Works to trees, although its excerpt names TPO felling only.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows for Minerals & waste (county) and Change of use - prior approval

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are garbled or merge two requirements' headings because table columns were read across: Lighting uses the EIA trigger ('Statement (EIA) External Lighting Scheme ... significant effect'); Ecology repeats the Air Quality cell; the Flood Risk excerpt is scrambled ('The site is 1 hectare the sequential and or greater'). Others are fragments: Cycle parking 'spaces and cycle storage areas in new developments.', Pre-application 'required unless pre-application advice indicates otherwise.', 'Schedule of works (listed building)', which is actually tree AMS and landscape maintenance text.
The 'Planning page' is the council homepage, not a planning validation page, so later checks have no landing page that links the current list.

summary: Grokbot's PDF could not be fetched (client error). The council updated its adopted local validation checklist on 3 July 2025, so Grokbot's February 2025 file, dated only from metadata, is probably superseded. Visible extraction problems include process text, garbled table triggers and odd app-type placements.
